articles.title: Houston Astros' offense once again in short supply as Tampa Bay Rays win another tight game
articles.description: Houston scored three or fewer runs for the 21st time in the past 35 games, failing to come up with timely hits in another low-scoring game against Tampa Bay.

articles.title: Houston Astros' Yordan Alvarez out of lineup for second straight game with sore ankle
articles.description: Manager Joe Espada said "it's still not there" as slugger Yordan Alvarez didn't start a second straight game against the AL-leading Rays.

articles.title: Postseason-bound Rays beat the Astros 3-2
articles.description: Richie Palacios had a two-run single in fifth, Ian Seymour threw six strong innings and Nick Madrigal had a clutch sacrifice fly to help the postseason-bound Tampa Bay Rays beat the Houston Astros ...

articles.title: Astros' Carlos Correa takes live batting practice in rehab for first time since ankle surgery
articles.description: Carlos Correa faced live pitching for the first time since May as he tries to return to the Astros before the end of the season.

articles.title: Houston Astros see what a playoff team looks like in loss to Rays and face their own shortcomings
articles.description: If a meeting with the owners of the AL’s best record is a barometer, the 3-1 loss to the Rays perhaps distilled the Astros current state.

articles.title: Bryan Abreu gives up 2-run homer in ninth as Houston Astros fall to Tampa Bay
articles.description: Junior Caminero cranked a walk-off, two-run home run against Bryan Abreu to send the Astros to a 3-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays, who clinched a playoff spot.

articles.title: Houston Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez gets a day off after turning his ankle in Philadelphia
articles.description: Friday marked just the third time Yordan Alvarez has been absent from the starting lineup in 148 games although he has started 123 of those at DH.

articles.title: Cristian Javier and Cam Smith may be 'starting to get hot at the right time' for Houston Astros
articles.description: Cristian Javier flashed his no-hit form from before elbow surgery and Cam Smith showed signs of breaking out as Astros head into final stretch ...

articles.title: Yordan Alvarez Triple Crown tracker: Updates on Houston Astros slugger's chase for history
articles.description: Yordan Alvarez's power numbers have sagged recently but he's still in the Triple Crown race trying to become just the second player to lead the league in average, home runs and RBIs since 1967.
